entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: Soratami prophet, tactician and warrior from Kamigawa, disciple of Uyo and right hand of Mochi.

entities.name: Uyo
entities.description: Silent prophet whose most advanced disciple was Chiyo.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: The Smiling Kami of Crescent Moon, patron spirit of the soratami.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Ochimusha who defeated Chiyo's agents and bested her repeatedly.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: Palace that is the seat of soratami power.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Kami bonded to Toshi who allowed him to choke Chiyo.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Kami who ascended after the destruction of O-Kagachi and Konda.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Lord destroyed in the climax of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest where the soratami armada was destroyed.

events.summary: Toshi defeats two of Chiyo's agents; Chiyo ambushes his house but he escapes, and she vows revenge.
Toshi appears at Otawara palace; Chiyo fights and is defeated, and an oni-dog ruins her face.
events.quote: her face was ruined forever - she lost an eye and her nose was broken

events.summary: Chiyo is frozen alive when Uyo's trick backfires, after which Mochi lets her kill Toshi.
events.quote: she was frozen alive by Toshi's stolen might of the yuki-onna

events.summary: Chiyo stabs Toshi through the lungs, but the Myojin lets him choke her with darkness.
events.quote: allowed him to choke Chiyo with solid darkness

relations.note: Chiyo is Uyo's disciple (Uyo mentors Chiyo).
relations.quote: She was the most advanced disciple of Uyo
a devoted follower and a right hand of Mochi
